I have some schooling, so I know fertilizer helps maize, but I still must think about cash. Last season I planted hybrid seed on part of the plot and it did better when I put fertilizer, so I will do the same again — if I get the FISP coupon I can afford one bag of NPK 23-21-0+4S for basal and one bag of urea for top-dressing on this 0.63 ha plot. I will also spread the manure from our few chickens and goats where I can, and because I am intercropping with beans or pigeon pea, that helps the soil too. I cannot irrigate — there is no river close by — and I will not buy pesticide for maize, I just weed by hand with my wife and younger brother.
